text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober, Mejiro Dober! Mejiro Dober 
takes the victory in this race!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible...!! She's on a completely 
different level from the Mejiro Dober 
we've known so far...!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Female Fan
text_block_list.text: Dober-chan... is dazzling...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Mejiro Dober-san! That 
was a wonderful race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. However... I'm not 
satisfied just yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Because there is a goal... an "ideal" I 
wish to surpass.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: An ideal to surpass...! C-Could that be—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I'll show them. My challenge, to all 
those people—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I... am going to challenge Air 
Groove-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: In the next... Queen Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So, please watch. Witness the running... 
of Mejiro Dober!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dober's Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
S-S-So cool...!! I am DEF-I-NITE-LY going 
to see that...!!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
Dober-chan...!!! You're so, so 
magnificent...!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Was that a bit of an exaggeration...? Now 
I'm starting to feel embarrassed...
choice_data_list: That was a pretty cool declaration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...You always say that, Trainer, so it 
kinda loses its meaning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just kidding. You're way too 
shocked. What a funny face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just kidding, just kidding. Thanks a 
lot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
…………All that's left is to wait for that 
day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
…………All that's left is to wait for that 
day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Please wait for me, Air Groove-senpai--

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The battleground, the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup, is right around the corner...!
